purpose: Independent practice of B2.2 (facts to 10) with explicit attention to commutativity (B2.1). Captures diagnostic-level evidence for the unit.
student_learning_goal: I can recall addition facts up to 10 and show that 3+4 and 4+3 have the same total.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can recall addition facts up to 10 and show that 3+4 and 4+3 have the same total.
header.character_watermark: Plus the Adding Pup in the top-right corner with a green '+' bandana, paws holding two-colour counters. Small (~1.5in tall).

parts.student_instructions: Each triangle holds two addition facts. Fill in the missing number on each triangle. Then write the two addition facts the triangle holds.
parts.visual_layout: Top half of the page. Six fact-family triangles arranged in a 2x3 grid. Each triangle is ~1.6in tall with a sum at the top and two addends at the bottom corners (one number missing in each). Below each triangle, two equation lines: '___ + ___ = ___' and '___ + ___ = ___'.

image_placeholders.description: Six fact-family triangles in B&W line-art, arranged in a 2-row × 3-column grid. Each triangle ~1.6in tall, with the sum number at the top vertex (in a circle) and two addend numbers at the bottom corners (in circles). One number per triangle is shown as a blank dotted circle. Pre-fills: T1 sum=7, addends 4 and ?; T2 sum=8, addends 3 and ?; T3 sum=10, addends 6 and ?; T4 sum=6, addends ? and 4; T5 sum=9, addends ? and 5; T6 sum=10, addends 7 and ?. Below each triangle, two equation lines.

parts.student_instructions: Each ten-frame shows red counters and yellow counters. Write the addition equation. Then write the SWAPPED equation underneath.
parts.visual_layout: Middle of the page. Four ten-frame scenes in a 2x2 grid. Each scene ~2.5in wide × 1.5in tall, showing a single ten-frame with red dots and yellow dots. Below each scene, two equation lines: '___ + ___ = ___' and 'Swap: ___ + ___ = ___'.

Red dots are solid filled circles; yellow dots are open (unfilled) circles. Below each ten-frame, two equation lines.

parts.part_title: Part 3: Plus the Pup's Two Paws
parts.student_instructions: Plus the Pup has 6 treats in one paw. He has some treats in the other paw. Plus has 9 treats ALTOGETHER. How many are in the second paw? Draw the answer and write the equation.
parts.visual_layout: Bottom of the page. Plus the Pup illustration with two paws extended. Left paw shows 6 treats. Right paw is empty (~3in × 2in box for the child to draw the missing treats). Below the illustration, an equation line: '6 + ___ = 9' and a second blank line for the answer sentence: 'There are ___ treats in the second paw.'

image_placeholders.description: Plus the Adding Pup illustration in B&W line-art, ~5in tall, sitting upright with both paws extended forward. Left paw holds 6 small round treats (drawn as circles). Right paw is empty with a light-grey 3in × 2in dashed-outline box where the child draws. Below the illustration, the equation line and the answer sentence.
image_placeholders.placement: Bottom of the page; full-width illustration plus equation and sentence lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: Image WS01_P3_PLUS_TWO_PAWS: keywords (paws, treats) name what the illustration shows.

parts.answer_key: Child draws 3 treats in the second paw. Equation: 6 + 3 = 9. Sentence: 'There are 3 treats in the second paw.'

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, flip the page over and write THREE more fact-family triangles of your own. Pick any three sums between 5 and 10.
teacher_notes: Lesson 1 consolidation. Hand out at the end of the Action phase. Most children should complete Parts 1 and 2 with minimal prompting. Watch for: (a) Part 1 children who write only ONE fact per triangle (missing the swap) — flag for commutativity reteach in Lesson 2 warm-up; (b) Part 2 children who get the equation but not the swap — same flag; (c) Part 3 children who count up from 6 vs. those who recall 6+3=9 — diagnostic evidence for fact-recall fluency. Use Part 1 results as evidence for the diagnostic checklist columns 'Recall fluent for facts to 10' and 'Can produce the swapped fact'.
